correctness.rationale: Unique Hilbert-block supports give J(x)(y)=a^{p−2}<u,ξ>+b^{p−2}<v,ζ>. Forward orthogonality forces opposite pairings; Cauchy-Schwarz yields scalar envelope maximized at ω=1/(1+τ), with equality only when both block pairings saturate. The explicit collinear pair attains envelope; z=logτ/2 gives hyperbolic profile. Conjugate change of variables and uniform exponential tail bound establish z0 tanh z0=1 near-Hilbert slope. All p∈(1,∞), arbitrary nonzero real Hilbert fibers; no extrapolation from finite tests.
